discipline_classification.excerpt: In this paper, we propose ENEC, a novel lossless compression method specifically customized for AI model weights and optimized for Ascend Neural Processing Units.
discipline_classification.reason: 研究人工智能模型权重压缩算法及其在专用处理器上的推理优化，属于计算机与人工智能技术研究。
